feat(ci): publish lris and camellia images

Summary:
- add a new lris wrapper binary and shared lris runtime image
- add a standalone camellia Dockerfile and frontend image jobs
- split dyn-workflows into rust artifact, lris image, and camellia image jobs

Rationale:
- DAM-39 rework replaces the spectra-only image with a shared lris image
  and removes migration startup behavior from the runtime image path
- camellia needs its own image path instead of being coupled to the Rust
  build flow, while spectra deploy references stay on the new lris image

Tests:
- cd lris && cargo check --workspace
- cd bougainvillea && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
- cd bougainvillea && pnpm run check:camellia
- docker build -f bougainvillea/apps/camellia/Dockerfile bougainvillea
- cd lris && docker build -f Dockerfile . (validated with temporary
  placeholder binaries because local disk pressure prevented a full local
  release artifact build; CI still builds real musl binaries)
